treatments.monitoring: PHASE 1 (Weeks 1-4): Baseline — defect rate (DPMO) using SPC control chart system. Deliverable: baseline report. PHASE 2 (Months 2-3): Early tracking — defect rate (DPMO) measured daily. Target: <500 DPMO. PHASE 3 (Months 4-6): Midpoint review — compare against Six Sigma 3.4 DPMO target. Target: 50% of goal.
